title: Funeral hymns and street repertoire
summary: They played hymns by ear, including Closer Walk and Saints, and funeral marches.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Did you play funeral marches? Did you play them from music? Or did you play them?
Oh, no. We could drum, what we used to play, we could play that from here. What a friend we have with Jesus.
Yeah. Oh, it's all hymns. Never Oh My God to See. All like that.
You remember in those days that they used some of the ones they use today or by and by. Did they use that?
Now what about Just a Closer Walk with the...
Walk with Jesus. That's right. See? Yeah. Just a Closer Walk. Did they use that along that road? Sure. Oh, see, all that's old stuff.
I think it was real old.
And now what about the Saints Go Marching In? They play that so much now. Was that an old... Did that just come popular lately or was it used?
Well, it was popular in my time. We'd be coming back. You used that. Yeah.
Another one that they use now is the Glory Land and Sing All.
Oh, yeah. All that. All that's that old stuff.
You used all those old numbers then?
The Eureka Band play... Now they play... Was it Flea the Bird?
Well, that's a march. That's a funeral march. I remember that.
Did you ever play funeral marching? Oh, yeah.
